description: Farming Simulator 25 dedicated server for Linux amd64 using the official GIANTS installer and GE-Proton.

variables.name: Allow Crossplay
variables.description: true or false. Blank keeps the web interface setting.

variables.name: Autosave Interval
variables.description: Minutes between saves. Blank keeps the web interface setting.

variables.name: Autostart Game
variables.description: Start the game when the GIANTS web interface is ready. Use false to start it manually from that interface.

variables.name: DLC Installation Sources
variables.description: Optional matching list: pumps=https://.../installer.exe;mercedes=installer.img. Local paths are relative to dlc-installers/. With no override, the DLC key is looked up at GIANTS.

variables.name: DLC Installer Timeout
variables.description: Maximum seconds per DLC installer, including online activation. The base game starts only after all configured DLC installers succeed.

variables.name: DLC Product Keys
variables.description: Optional admin-only list: pumps=KEY;mercedes=KEY. Use matching names in DLC Installation Sources. Blank leaves DLC installation disabled unless a key file is present.

variables.name: Enable TLS
variables.description: Requires game/cert.pem and game/pk.pem. Allocate the TLS port before enabling.

variables.name: GE-Proton Release
variables.description: Pinned GE-Proton release. Apply changes by reinstalling. Changing this may require activation again.

variables.name: GIANTS IMG Download Link
variables.description: Optional direct HTTPS .img link from the GIANTS CDN. Blank looks up the base game with the product key.

variables.name: GIANTS Product Key
variables.description: Admin only. FS25 product key for the GIANTS download and first activation. Blank uses .fs25-secrets/activation-key if present. Wings may log egg variables during installation.

variables.name: Max Players
variables.description: Player slots (2–16). Blank keeps the web interface setting.

variables.name: Pause When Empty
variables.description: 1 = no, 2 = immediately. Blank keeps the web interface setting.

variables.name: Savegame Slot
variables.description: Savegame slot. Blank keeps the web interface setting.

variables.name: Server Language
variables.description: FS25 language code. Blank keeps the web interface setting.

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: In-game server browser name. Blank keeps the web interface setting.

variables.name: Stats Interval
variables.description: Minutes between stats writes. Blank keeps the web interface setting.

variables.name: Web Admin Username
variables.description: Admin login for the GIANTS web interface. Set a password in .fs25-secrets/web-admin-password, or use the one generated in game/dedicatedServer.xml.

variables.name: Web Interface Port
variables.description: TCP allocation for the GIANTS web interface.

variables.name: Web Interface TLS Port
variables.description: Additional TCP allocation when TLS is enabled.
